messages:
maria: Heads-up: docs sprint item - we need a tiny, copy-pasteable example demonstrating tenant surge handling for Dedicated. Focus: autoscale policy, isolation label, and fallback routing. Keep it under 10 lines of YAML + one CLI line.

nick: I can sketch. Prefer showing both a burst policy and a steady policy side-by-side so readers know which to pick.

sung: Make the burst policy have short cooldown and higher max_replicas. Add an annotation comment about cost + SLO tradeoff.

maria: Yes, and include an explicit note: strict isolation => reserved pool => preemption unlikely; soft isolation => shared pool => possible eviction.

nick: Draft below. Quick and pragmatic.```yaml
# burst policy: for unpredictable spikes
name: surge-burst
min_replicas: 1
max_replicas: 30
cpu_threshold_pct: 70
cooldown_seconds: 20
annotations:
  isolation: strict    # reserved pool, higher cost, higher SLO
routing:
  fallback_model: "gptq-1.7b-quant"

# steady policy: for baseline traffic
name: surge-steady
min_replicas: 2
max_replicas: 8
cpu_threshold_pct: 60
cooldown_seconds: 300
annotations:
  isolation: soft      # shared pool, cost-efficient, expect possible preemption
```

tara: Nice. Add one CLI example for setting tenant label and one troubleshooting bullet about eviction loops.

nick: Added CLI + troubleshooting in PR description. CLI: `rwctl tenant set-label --tenant t-42 --label isolation=strict`

sung: Suggest small cost note: "approx $0.10-0.18/hr per replica depending on instance type" and a short SLA callout: "strict isolation: 99.9% availability; soft: best-effort". Keep it approximate.

maria: Sounds good. Could we also add a one-line migration tip: when moving tenants from soft->strict, pre-warm replicas to avoid cold-start throttling.

docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4987 — includes YAML example, CLI, and troubleshooting notes. Reviewers requested: @maria @sung

tara: I'll review after standup. small nit: change cooldown_seconds in burst to 15 to match runtime defaults?

nick: switched to 15 and pushed.

maria: LGTM, merging once CI passes. I'll add a pointer from the provisioning checklist and a cross-link to the SLA page. Thanks everyone :party-popper:
